Thanksgiving Announcement 9/2/2026:

I know this particularly will interest @ilya_nikitenko but a testimony regardless I thought worth sharing to everyone here as an encouraging to keep on evangelizing in places you just never think where Jesus would visit (or you might, I don't know😂)

I came across the Church of Scientology on Facebook ads and as much as I know of them and seen online, they are a satanic cult (obviously still are) but something inside of me wanted to go and share the gospel of Jesus Christ with them so I can preach/evangelize at this gathering about Jesus' name and hand out Bibles

So yesterday I had an opportunity to talk about Jesus over there and to preach to the gathering as it was a communication workshop, even debating or speaking to a Muslim brother about Jesus and Muhammad.

There were staff members that I also spoke with and honestly gained a supporter from the Church of Scientology to fight against drugs in our state which is amazing who also participated in handing out material during the FIFA World Cup where I was also.

The message is always the same, Jesus is the Way, the Truth, and the Life, and no one comes to the Father except through Him and no one can oppose this Truth. Needless to say, I felt like I made friends in the Church of Scientology and these workshops are something (even Christians from what I heard) visit and this Church of Scientology "claims" they received help from. They were even as bold as to go to say that a Baptist Minister had lots of success because he uses their strategies but little do they know that all the strategies they used were actually the same ones that the enemy Satan used on Jesus during his 40-day fast in the wilderness. I recorded audio and have some videos so our team will post the video once it's ready on Instagram but praise Jesus for His opportunity!

Hey guys, wanted to drop prayer requests from Mondays evangelism here of who we met during our time at Wilcox park. These are from my notes:

Pray for the first (maybe homeless) guy we met on a bike. He wasn’t interested in a Bible or snacks, but pray that he encounters Jesus and receives help.

Pray for Alejandro. He didn’t specify for what, but he seemed in a rush and possibly distressed. Said he had a so-so day. 

Pray for the homeless cluster we encountered, and for one of the guys mom, rose. Prayer for his mom’s foot to be healed and for her to get her car back.

Pray for sweet old lady named Lory. She was Christian and blessed us on our journey.

Pray for Matthew, young fisherman we met on the dock. Pray that he catches a fish and also is inspired to read the Bible more after our encounter with him.

Pray for Doug the birdwatcher. He didn’t seem interested but pray that a seed was planted in his heart.

This prayer list would be even longer if Lin and I actually wrote down but there's like 20 more people to add so continue praying for Lynnwood and the Revival to happen in Washington state in Jesus name
Please add more here for the people you at least can remember!
January 10th will be our next prayer night. I need to ping people to get confirmation we have the space.

Collected Prayer Requests from @ilya_nikitenko :

1. A young woman seeking Christ. She told us she’s genuinely interested in Christianity and wants to learn more. Her questions felt sincere. Please pray that the Lord continues to reveal Himself to her and draws her in.
 2. A farmers market volunteer’s daughter. One of our volunteers at the market shared that his daughter is in the hospital right now under close watch after a mental health crisis. She’s a believer, married with a family, but has battled depression for years. Please pray for her safety, for relief from the darkness she’s carrying, and for strength for him and the rest of the family.
 3. My barber’s girlfriend. She has a serious kidney condition and her life is in danger. He identifies as a Christian but isn’t walking with the Lord. Pray for her healing — and that God would use this to bring him back to Himself.
 4. A contractor I used to work with. He’s in the middle of a painful divorce with serious accusations against him, and his wife is seeking full custody of the children. He specifically asked for our prayer support. Pray for truth to come out, for his children, and for God to sustain him.

Thank you all for standing in the gap. Let’s keep lifting these up this week.

He explained that the state denied his insurance, he doesn't have housing, and he lost his leg from the frost bite. I asked him what we could pray for him for and he said a better future. He is also a human and he deserves better like all of us, I gave him my business card but lets pray for him to receive help wherever it is possible.
Thank you Liam
